title: P18.6 — Semantic-First Goal Understanding + closures: guarded evidence binding, strict snapshot scope, EXACT approval identity (canonical-statement issue keys — negation/order/entity/quantity preserved, paraphrase never proves review)
description: P18.6 EXACT-IDENTITY closure on base cabd25d - final approval-identity hardening. Prior discriminating-token-SET keys still discarded negation (do-not vs do collided), word order/direction (alice->bob vs bob->alice; mysql->postgres vs postgres->mysql collided), single-letter identifiers (tier a vs tier b). Replaced lossy set equivalence with a provenance-bound CANONICAL STATEMENT identity: issueKeyFor = category + canonical statement (NFC, lowercase, d-with-stroke fold, NFD strip marks, punctuation->space, whitespace collapse) preserving negation, direction, entity, quantity, unit, relationship and scope verbatim. Identical issues (canonical surface variants) reuse approval and idempotent retries stay intact; ANY provable difference - including AI paraphrase - requires explicit owner review (fail closed by construction; paraphrase similarity is never approval evidence). Material items in the confirmed revision must each be covered by an approved issue with identical category + issue_key. Owner decisions distinguished (accepted_assumption vs supplied_value, digest-bound); endpoint enforces READY mint-lifecycle + authenticated operator + preview ownership; verify re-derives statements + issues + resolutions bijectively vs amended-goal lines (tamper fails closed). Adversarial probes: negation flips, word-order/direction, single-letter, entity/channel/quantity/project swaps - over HTTP + real confirm seam. Prior closures (guarded evidence binding, strict snapshot scope) unchanged. Baseline: interpretation ADVISORY only; OFF default; no auto-merge.
